Rules.InvariantScript:
Sort(
    Filter(
        Equipment_Tickets,
        drpTicketFilter.Selected.Value = "All"
            || (drpTicketFilter.Selected.Value = "Unresolved" && IsBlank(ResolvedDate))
            || (drpTicketFilter.Selected.Value = "My reports"
                && ReportedBy.Email = User().Email)
    ),
    ReportedDate,
    SortOrder.Descending
)

Coalesce(ThisItem.ReportedBy.DisplayName, "?") &
 If(IsBlank(ThisItem.ReportedDate), "", "  on " & Text(ThisItem.ReportedDate, DateTimeFormat.ShortDate)) &
 "   |   " & Coalesce(ThisItem.TypeMaintenance.Value, "")
